intent: Implement CorrelationContext (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Shared static-only holder (all members bound static in the table) that is the single owner of the correlation key literals requestId, the header X-Request-Id and the absent marker UNCORRELATED. Correlation lives in the Reactor Context and in the audit record's correlationId field; no MDC and no context-propagation library is used, so log lines do not carry the id (declared).

methods.semantics: Returns exactly requestId, the Reactor Context key and audit correlation key.
Emits the requestId from the subscriber's Reactor Context; emits UNCORRELATED when the key is absent. Never empty, never errors.
Returns exactly X-Request-Id, the HTTP header carrying the requestId.
